verdict.rationale: Honeycomb is a SaaS observability product; no evidence pack item mentions self-hosting, on-prem deployment, or an upgrade path for a self-managed stack — all docs reference Honeycomb's own hosted platform and pricing tiers. This is an applicable axis (self-hosted observability stacks exist as a category, e.g. open-source alternatives) but Honeycomb offers no documented self-hosted deployment option.
